Managed framework APIs with no added package/assets, workload, provider or rendering mode. BFloat16 exists only on .NET11 here. The SDK11/net10 experiment establishes rebuild behavior on actual runtime10, not a .NET10 route to new runtime APIs. No AOT or device execution is established.

evidence.scope: Real target executions assert exact decimal values, both original BigInteger destination bit patterns, ties-to-even, and exceptions for NaN/infinity. This is not a full audit of every conversion direction, Math.Round migration or older-target/newer-SDK route. Actual managed execution; no mocks, cross-compilation or GA verification.

Real invariant G7/G15 policy with signs, exact ties-to-even, exponents, underflow, large finite values, range and nonfinite rejection. Parsed runtime inputs check Decimal-to-double/float/Half and BigInteger-to-double/float/Half, constructor/Convert/IConvertible/generic routes, negative symmetry, Half finite/tie/overflow controls and the retained extreme-midpoint limitation. Constants are read from embedded metadata separately from runtime casts. BFloat16 is tested only on net11. Compiler/ref/runtime hashes and exact no-package closure recorded; bounded managed evidence, not a universal conversion audit or GA proof.
